observations: Selected orthogonal source planes show detailed cortical/trabecular architecture, posterior osseous structures, an intervening disc region and surrounding support material.
Two dominant vertebral-body profiles are apparent in the selected longitudinal source planes. This is not an exhaustive anatomical count and does not independently establish level names.
The sampled DICOM descriptive fields contain no L4/L5/S1 level tokens.
No boundary sample exceeds 600 HU at the first/last slice faces; other faces contain higher values, including five samples above 1000 HU at the final column face.

Establish individual vertebral identity and specimen orientation before clinical level-specific bindings.

boundary_followup.finding: All five >1000 HU contacts are one six-connected cluster confined to native column 2007, rows 1474–1476, slices 1497–1498. In reviewed full planes they are peripheral to the visible osseous profiles; unmarked local patches show an isolated edge signal rather than a recognizable cortical structure.
